notes.title: WLB v. 1.0.5
notes.content:
Version 1.0.5 is live! This update brings more bug fixes and a small quality of life improvement.

[b]Change Log v1.0.5[/b]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Edict menu will no longer fly in and out at near the speed of light
[*] Edits now always function properly
[*] Tech Level objectives will now always properly display as completed once research is complete
[*] Defense rating will no long climb to astronomical numbers
[*] Research should now always update once complete and not display "In progress..."
[/list]

[b]Quality of life improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the shade of green for positive resource production to provide improved contrast
[/list]

Thanks for playing! If you discover any bugs, please post them to the discussion board in the What's Left Behind community page, ping me on Twitter @HoovlerInd or email me at hooviegames@yahoo.com

notes.title: WLB v. 1.0.4
notes.content:
Thanks for playing What's Left Behind! I'm striving to stamp out all those pesky bugs that managed to sneak out the door at release and I think this update should resolve most of the outstanding ones. Of course, if you find any others, let me know!

[h1]Change Log v. 1.0.4[/h1]

[b]Bug fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue that prevented Landscaping building from finishing construction
[*] Biomass Power Plants will no longer remain without workers if they are destroyed and rebuilt
[*] Fixed an issue where building would remain in queue to recevie workers, even if they were not active
[*] Power consumption should now work properly
[*] When loading a saved game, power production will now load correctly
[*] Game can no longer be paused while player is in the cheat console
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented player from utilizing tiles at the edge of the map
[*] Grid will now display properly on all maps when Expansionist Policies is fully upgraded
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented player from interacting with player-built structures after initiating demolition of run down buildings
[*] Fixed an issue with occasional non-localized pop-up hints
[/list]

[b]Feature updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Added ponds to several maps so that players may complete Build a Water Pump objective
[/list]

Please note that, due to necessary changes in the game's code, save files from older versions of the game may not be compatible with v. 1.0.4. I apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. If you find any bugs, please report them to @HoovlerInd on Twitter or hooviegames@yahoo.com

notes.title: WLB v. 1.0.3
notes.content:
CHANGE LOG v 1.0.3

The following bugs have been addressed in this version of the game:
[list]
[*] Pausing the game via the "+/-" or "P" inputs will no longer cause the game to crash
[*] Fixed an issue that sometimes prevented player-made structures from properly playing audio when selected
[*] Sometimes, when demolishing a player-build structure, that tile was no longer eligible for construction. This has been fixed.
[*] The above issue also sometimes occurred when loading saved games. This too have been fixed.
[*] Previously the player was able to alter the speed of the game while the pause menu was open. This has been rectified.
[/list]

Please note that as with all updates, save files from previous versions of the game may not be compatible or may not function properly. I apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

If you are experiencing issues, please make sure you are playing on the most recent version of the game. If you have the most recent version of the game downloaded and are still experiencing issues, please let me know at @HoovlerInd on Twitter or via email at hooviegames@yahoo.com

The above issue also sometimes occurred when loading saved games. This too have been fixed.

notes.title: WLB v. 1.0.2 is live
notes.content:
[h1][b]Change Log v 1.0.2[/b][/h1]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Resource storage to will no longer increase when loading a saved game
[*] Town Hall would sometimes not upgrade with tech level research. This has been resolved.
[*] Monuments would sometimes not permit you to rebuild even if all requirements were met. This has been fixed.
[*] Monuments will now always load properly once they are reconstructed
[*] At faster game speeds mouse clicks were not always responsive. This has been resolved.
[/list]

[b]Known issues[/b]
There are still occasional reports of some saved files not loading properly. Please note that older save files may not be compatible with newer versions of the game. I apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Should you encounter this issue, please ensure that you are loading a file compatible with v. 1.0.2 of the game. If the issue persists, please report it to @HoovlerInd on Twitter or hooviegames@yahoo.com

notes.title: WLB Version 1.0.1 is live
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

First off, thanks for downloading What's Left Behind.

Version 1.0.1 is here and it's mostly just bug fixes for things that managed to sneak out the door with version 1.0. Of course, if you find any bugs left over, please let me know so that I can fix them ASAP.

[b]Change Log v. 1.0.1[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused upgrades to stall if changing menus while they were running
[*] Fixed a bug that kept player from being able to research Standardized Crating
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Resource Overlays to become stuck visible
[*] Fixed a bug where player could not complete "Build a..." objectives
[*] Fixed a bug where settlers were not visible
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented monuments from saving properly
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented player-built structures from loading properly when a saved game was loaded
[*] Changed camera idle animation so that when player returns to play the camera will now snap back to last position
[/list]
